assessments.reasoning: In its comparison with versions starting at .NET 2002, Microsoft explicitly identifies Windows client applications as the target of the earlier versions. The claim accurately attributes this retrospective characterization to the migration guide.

challenge.method: Check whether the target was inferred only from the later web-service discussion and whether the guide claims exclusivity.
challenge.results: The earlier target is stated directly. The passage describes intended use and leaves other deployments and differences among earlier releases open.

limitations: The target description does not exclude all other deployments or say that classic Visual Basic tools implement an identical language across all releases.
